dct_description_sm: The aim of the ArcticNet Industry collaborative Marine Observatories project was to extend the ArcticNet time series of environmental data collected in the Beaufort Sea with a special focus on the industry exploration acreages EL446, EL449 and EL451 and therefore better understand the variability, extremes and trends of ocean and ice conditions in this area. The Imperial Oil Ltd. (IOL) was one of the main industry partners. The specific objectives of the project were: 1) quantify and resolve the along-shelf and across-shelf seasonal and annual variability in ocean circulation; 2) quantify the seasonal and annual complexity and variability of water column structure, water mass properties, biogeochemical cycling, and particle flux from ocean to seabed in the exploration acreages; and 3) detect and quantify the abundance and characteristics of sea ice and marine glacial ice features that pose a hazard to offshore exploration.
dct_title_s: ArcticNet/IOL - Industry Marine Observatories (moorings) in the Beaufort Sea (2009-2011)
